name: orchestration-skills
description: Rules for handing work to other agents without losing control of it: what is worth delegating, what every brief must include, which agents worktree isolation breaks, which tier each stage runs at, how to tell a finished stage from one that merely stopped talking, and when to stop and ask the user instead of deciding alone.

mechanicalModel.title: Mechanical model
mechanicalModel.description: The model of the mechanical tier, for a stage whose failure is loud: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, or fable) or a model id.

mechanicalEffort.title: Mechanical effort
mechanicalEffort.description: The effort of the mechanical tier.

routineModel.title: Routine model
routineModel.description: The model of the routine tier, for a well-specified unit with an objective check: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, or fable) or a model id.

routineEffort.title: Routine effort
routineEffort.description: The effort of the routine tier.

complexModel.title: Complex model
complexModel.description: The model of the complex tier, for the main loop and a loosely specified build stage: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, or fable) or a model id.

complexEffort.title: Complex effort
complexEffort.description: The effort of the complex tier.

criticalModel.title: Critical model
criticalModel.description: The model of the critical tier, for design, adversarial verification, and judge stages: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, or fable) or a model id.

criticalEffort.title: Critical effort
criticalEffort.description: The effort of the critical tier.

escalationModel.title: Escalation model
escalationModel.description: The model of the escalation tier, for a stage the critical tier left open: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, or fable) or a model id. On an account not served Fable 5.2, set it to opus with the effort at max.

escalationEffort.title: Escalation effort
escalationEffort.description: The effort of the escalation tier.
